inputs.revision: OS source base db34405faaff2ab9ef72b73bed3643eb19159565 plus the ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI profile diff published as ea9f2751d407ab887268ad87a56445fd187c350a

inputs.name: Static FFS RAM root with console tools

scenario: Boot the configured EmberBSD Wi-Fi kernel and RAM root, enumerate the ESP radio interface, bring it up, and run `/sbin/ifconfig espwifi0 list scan`. Do not associate to an access point.
expected: The interface enumerates and the active scan returns access-point records without attempting association.
observed: `espwifi0` enumerated and was brought up. The vendor scan reported 14 AP records in one pass and 16 in a second pass; these are pass counts, not a unique-network count. The log recorded 42 `wpa_parse_wpa_ie function not found` errors across interface bring-up and scan. Therefore reported auth enums cannot be trusted as security classifications. The command returned to the shell; no association or DHCP was attempted.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and one RAM-only boot; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The scan was active. Repeated WPA IE parser callback errors make security classification unreliable.
No association, authentication, DHCP, roaming or sustained transfer was tested.
